The application alone does not contain live channels for streaming. However, users can request a free 24-hour trial from RabbitAI TV via WhatsApp by clicking here.

![TiviMate Installation Guide](/images/blog/tivimate-installation.jpg)

## Step 1 - Prepare Your Streaming Device

**1.** From your device's home screen, hover over the Search button, then click on the Search box.

![Search for Downloader](/images/blog/tivimate/step1-search-downloader.jpg)

**2.** Search for and select **Downloader**.

**3.** Choose the Downloader application.

**4.** Click Download or Get if the application is not yet downloaded. If you have already installed the Downloader application, skip directly to Step 2.

**5.** Wait for the application to be installed.

**6.** You will receive the message "Downloader Ready to launch!"

## Step 2 - Allow Downloader to Install TiviMate IPTV 8K Player Application

**1.** Return to the home screen, hover over Settings, and click on My Fire TV.

**2.** Choose Developer Options.

**IMPORTANT:** Please see the notes below if you do not see Developer Options on your screen.

**3.** Click on Install Unknown Apps.

**4.** Find the Downloader application and click on it.

**5.** This will enable unknown sources for the Downloader application and allow sideloading on your device.

## If Developer Options Were Not Available in Step 2, Follow These Steps. Otherwise, Skip to Step 3

If you cannot locate Developer Options in Settings, follow the instructions below to enable the use of the Downloader application.

**1.** Hover over the Settings icon and click on **My Fire TV**.

**2.** Click on **About**.

**Note:** Notice that Developer Options are missing.

**3.** Hover over **Fire TV Stick** and click **7 times** on the OK button of your remote to become a developer.

**4.** Click the Back button on your remote and you will notice that Developer Options are now displayed in My Fire TV.

**5.** Click on Install Unknown Apps.

**6.** Find the Downloader application and click on it.

**7.** This will enable unknown sources for the Downloader application and allow sideloading on your device.

Now that you have properly prepared your Firestick, it's time to move to the next step.

## Step 3 - Download and Install TiviMate IPTV 8K Player

**1.** Launch the Downloader application from your Fire Stick's home screen.

**2.** Click Allow when the popup appears.

**3.** Click on the URL box.

**Note:** If you don't see the screen below, click on the Home tab in the lower left corner.

**4.** Enter the following URL address **exactly as shown**, then click GO:

**https://tivimate.com/download**

![Download TiviMate](/images/blog/tivimate/step2-download-tivimate.jpg)

**5.** Wait for the APK file to download to your device.

**6.** Once the download is complete, click Install.

**7.** Wait for the installation to complete.

**8.** Click **Done**. Do not click on **Open**.

**9.** Choose **Delete** to erase the APK file and free up space.

**10.** Click to return to the Downloader main screen.

## Step 4 - Configure TiviMate IPTV 8K Player

**1.** To open TiviMate, hover over the Search icon in your main menu and search for **TiviMate**.

**2.** Click on the application icon to launch the application.

**3.** Select **Continue**.

**4.** Select **Add Playlist**.

![Add Playlist](/images/blog/tivimate/step3-add-playlist.jpg)

**5.** Select **Xtream Codes login**.

**6.** Now, enter your credentials provided by your IPTV provider (or use your RabbitAI TV free trial).

![Enter Credentials](/images/blog/tivimate/step4-login.jpg)

- In the **Title** bar, enter your preferred name to identify your playlist (e.g., RabbitAI TV)
- **Name/Username**: Your username
- **Password**: Your password
- **URL or Address**: Your server URL

**7.** Click **Next** in the lower right corner of the screen to continue.

## The Future is Here: IPTV in 2026

As we move further into 2026, the world of IPTV has reached new heights of innovation. If you thought 4K was the limit, think again. The technology powering our screens has evolved to deliver experiences that were once considered science fiction.

### 1. The 8K Revolution

While 4K became the standard in 2024, **2026 is the year of 8K streaming**. With the rollout of wider fiber-optic networks and more efficient video codecs, true 8K resolution is now available for premium live sports and blockbuster movies. This provides four times the detail of 4K, making you feel like you're actually in the stadium or on the film set.

### 2. AI-Driven Personalization

Artificial Intelligence is no longer just a buzzword; it's the brain behind your IPTV interface. Modern services now use machine learning to:
- **Predict what you want to watch** based on your mood and time of day.
- **Automatically generate highlights** of sports matches you missed.
- **Upscale older content** in real-time to match your screen's resolution.

### 3. Latency Zero: The End of Buffering

In 2026, "Anti-Freeze" technology has evolved into **Multi-CDN Load Balancing**. By splitting the stream across multiple content delivery networks simultaneously, providers like RabbitAI TV have virtually eliminated buffering, even during global events like the World Cup.

### 4. 5G/6G Integration

Mobile streaming is faster than ever. With 5G now being the baseline and 6G trials beginning in tech hubs, you can stream consistent 4K content on your tablet or smartphone even while traveling at high speeds. The days of 'pixelation' on the go are officially over.

The IPTV landscape in 2026 is about more than just 'channels'—it's about a seamless, high-definition, and personalized gateway to global culture.
